exposure: Surgical intervention type (standard elective cesarean section vs organ-saving method)
Placenta previa alone vs Placenta previa with PAS
outcome: Time from start of operation to fetal extraction
cohort: 106 pregnant women with prenatal diagnosis of Placenta previa and the possibility of safe pregnancy prolongation until 34-36 weeks of gestation.
finding: The organ-saving surgical method for delivery in pregnant women with Placenta previa alone or with PAS significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss, MOH development, and hysterectomy rates compared to the standard elective cesarean section.
